title: [SEC1] Add validation for systemd unit file environment variables
description:
Risk: Environment variables are defined in crates/kithd/src/config.rs but documented (not validated) in contrib/systemd/{kithd.service,kithd@.service} as Environment= directives. If a future refactor renames KITHD_PORT to KITHD_LISTEN_PORT, or adds a new KITHD_CERT_EXPIRY, the unit files become incorrect. No tooling detects the drift.

Maintainer burden: Must manually audit both systemd files on every config change; risk of misconfiguration on deployment.

Mitigation: Add a test that validates the unit files contain references to all documented env vars in config.rs, or generate the Environment= directives from config.rs documentation.
